mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT N.NOTIFICATION_NO, N.RECIPIENT_NO, N.SENDER_NO, N.NOTIFICATION_TYPE, N.TARGET_TYPE, N.TARGET_NO, N.TITLE, N.CONTENT, N.READ_FL, N.STATUS, TO_CHAR(N.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, M.NICKNAME AS SENDER_NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMAGE AS SENDER_PROFILE_IMG, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY N.CREATED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM NOTIFICATION N LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON N.SENDER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE N.RECIPIENT_NO = #{recipientNo} AND N.STATUS = 'A' ) WHERE RN BETWEEN #{offset} + 1 AND #{offset} + #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE RECIPIENT_NO = #{recipientNo} AND STATUS = 'A'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE RECIPIENT_NO = #{recipientNo} AND READ_FL = 'N' AND STATUS = 'A'
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET READ_FL = 'Y' WHERE RECIPIENT_NO = #{recipientNo} AND READ_FL = 'N' AND STATUS = 'A'
